project.name: camunda-web-ui
project.description: Cockpit, Tasklist, and Admin - Camunda's prebuilt camunda-webapp WAR, overlaid as-is (no local src/main/webapp of our own; everything comes from the overlay unless a specific file needs overriding). Deployed as its own EAR subdeployment, genuinely separate from camunda-engine.war, the way process-application is - but unlike process-application, this one isn't decoupled from the engine: Cockpit/Tasklist/Admin need direct Java-API access to the running ProcessEngine (via org.camunda.bpm.engine.ProcessEngines), not just REST. That access comes for free without any explicit jboss-deployment-structure.xml module dependency between the two WARs: camunda-engine.jar itself lives in ear/lib/ (shared across all subdeployments regardless of ear-subdeployments-isolated - isolation only affects subdeployments seeing each other's own classes, not the shared EAR library directory), and camunda-webapp's own WEB-INF/lib deliberately does NOT bundle a second copy of camunda-engine.jar (confirmed by inspecting the published artifact) - so this WAR's ProcessEngines lookup resolves against the exact same shared class, and therefore the exact same registered engine, that CamundaEngineBootstrap in camunda-engine.war initialized.
